new-york-hawk-s-nest-and-delaware-river-.slogan: A 236 km loop out of Middletown

sections.advice: This Port Jervis food stop → Hawk’s Nest cliff road stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

sections.advice: Use Hawk’s Nest cliff road → Delaware River view as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 61 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-grand-ventron-pointe-de-montbec-i.story: From La Bresse it runs 366 km to La Bresse; allow about 6 h 19 of riding. The stops in between: Forêt de la Bettlachstock, Pointe de Montbec I and back through Forêt de la Bettlachstock. The highest point is about 800 m. It crosses from France into Switzerland - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
